Compassionate & Advanced Care for Your Pet
Welcome to Broward Veterinary Specialists! As a premier multi-specialty referral practice, we are dedicated to delivering state-of-the-art care across several disciplines, including
Surgery
,
Internal Medicine
, and
Oncology
. Our expertise lies in diagnosing and treating surgical, oncological, and internal diseases in both dogs and cats.
Conveniently located in Hollywood, Florida, we proudly serve pet owners throughout South Florida. We view you and your pet as family, and we are dedicated to providing you with all available options for diagnostics and therapies. Together, with the guidance of your family veterinarian, we will help you make informed decisions about the best course of action for your pet.
To request an appointment or obtain further information,
simply click HERE
.
We look forward to assisting you and your pet on their journey to health and wellness!
